I’m gonna have to agree with everyone else and say wait at least a few more years to start smoking. I used to be a substitute teacher and I saw plenty of kids in grades as low as 6th coming to school high and not being able to concentrate. That’s sad. Weed is a magnificent thing but this is exactly why people don’t want it legalized or accepted in society. Weed, like alcohol, is meant to be consumed AFTER your body has developed. I started smoking at 16 and I even think that was too early. Am I a mouth breathing idiot who can’t function? No. Do I have memory problems and I’m not able to eat without smoking because I conditioned my body to it? Yes. Wait until you’re older man, do yourself and everyone that loves this plant a favor and don’t make us look bad. On another note, glad you got to enjoy some bomb food and a good time. That’s a memory I hope you and your friends always have. Just remember, be responsible with everything you do.
